en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear; reads like a modern composed song but I cannot name an author. 'јанѕа имаш' is my reading: roughly 'are you troubled/anxious'. 'Си го прости господ Стојана' means the letter announces Stojan's death.

lines.cyr: Зората си зори, мајка дворој мети,
lines.lat: Zorata si zori, majka dvoroj meti,
lines.en: Dawn is breaking, mother sweeps the yard,

lines.cyr: после двајсе лета татко од гурбет си иди,
lines.lat: posle dvajse leta tatko od gurbet si idi,
lines.en: after twenty years father is coming back from abroad,
home, poor man, to gather himself in.

lines.cyr: - Мамо мила, мамо, оти прсти кршиш?
lines.lat: - Mamo mila, mamo, oti prsti kršiš?
lines.en: - Mother dear, mother, why do you crack your fingers?

lines.cyr: Оти прсти кршиш, мамо, оти очи криеш,
lines.lat: Oti prsti kršiš, mamo, oti oči krieš,
lines.en: Why do you crack your fingers, mother, why do you hide your eyes,

lines.cyr: јанѕа имаш ти што не спиеш?
lines.lat: jandza imaš ti što ne spieš?
lines.en: are you worried that you do not sleep?
The dogs bark, the first roosters crow,

lines.cyr: и на порти некој торпа, в' гради срце скокна,
lines.lat: i na porti nekoj torpa, v' gradi srce skokna,
lines.en: and at the gate someone knocks, the heart leaps in the chest,
here is our master of the house!

lines.cyr: Стрча мајка боса, резето го тргна,
lines.lat: Strča majka bosa, rezeto go trgna,
lines.en: Mother runs barefoot, she pulls the latch,

lines.cyr: а пред порти само писмо, и во писмо абер:
lines.lat: a pred porti samo pismo, i vo pismo aber:
lines.en: but before the gate there is only a letter, and in the letter news:
